passages.quote:
Recruiting somebody recovering from drug and alcohol misuse can result in a loyal, motivated and reliable employee who can often provide a fresh perspective to your business.

Actions to consider

If you’re thinking about recruiting somebody in recovery, you should:

promote a culture of understanding about drug and alcohol misuse in your workplace

introduce a regular work pattern for those in recovery where possible – this helps employees to maintain their routine

have a clear drug and alcohol policy in place so all employees know what is expected of them

Jobcentre support

Jobcentre Plus has a range of recruitment services that can help employers support those in recovery with moving into work:

work trials

sector-based work academies

Access to Work

More information

Business in the Community drugs, alcohol and tobacco toolkit for employers

Collective Voice provide advice and support to employers and individuals

Disability Confident provides advice on recruiting high quality staff from the widest possible pool of talent
